_what: notebook folders for the try page's machine-log check, and what notebook.py verify said about each
_produced_by: scripts/make_machine_log_fixture.py: tools/machine-notebook/notebook.py and tet-cli agent sign/verify
_device_key: not included; each device phrase was discarded with its temp folder

cases.name: valid
cases.why: four records, record 2 cites a permit once

verify.stdout:
VALID
  4 records, all signed by tet-ed25519:fa2543c75436dd233346890a3ed593ab6355a70c5c332dfae0b65647218b3d06
  permit 853c485579fe958c5ec56bc3b1c575f9 (open-valve): used once, by record 2; open until seq 3
Shows:
  - which key signed each record
  - that the records are in this order
  - that each record names the hash of the one before it
  - that no one-time permission was used twice in this log, or after it ran out
Does not show:
  - that the reading is true
  - that the machine's clock was right
  - where the machine was
  - who runs the machine
  - that the key was not copied
  - that a copied key did not use the same permission in another log
  - that the log is complete: its newest records may be missing, or rewritten by whoever holds the key
  - that the signature format is final: it is in outside review, and logs from this test may need re-signing
end: record 4 is the newest in this folder, sha256 ca97c34efaa3f3551410633949203afdfd5b4e9a2cca5f18160e3475588fab2c; records after it, if any, cannot be seen here
stamp: not checked (no node)
note: this folder holds device.key, and whoever has a copy can sign as this device; to hand the log over, give an export (notebook.py export), which leaves it out
